name: 16-heal-in-pewter
objective: Walk across Pewter City to its Pokemon Center and heal the party at the counter, before going anywhere near the gym.
evidence: watch:last_blackout_map=0x02 - wLastBlackoutMap $D719, which the atlas records as 'where blacking out returns you - the last Pokemon Center you healed at'. It holds the TOWN, not the Center's interior map: measured $01 (Viridian City) on every state of the certified link-14 pool.

THE FLIP IS THE PROOF OF THE INTERACTION AND FULL HP IS NOT, because a party that was never hurt is at full HP too. Measured both halves separately: a run whose goal was merely reaching map $3A ended inside Pewter's Pokemon Center with $D719 still reading $01, so entering does not set it; a run that walked to (3,3) and talked to the nurse left it reading $02. The cartridge writes it in DisplayPokemonCenterDialogue's call to SetLastBlackoutMap.

party_missing_hp=0 AND map=0x3A are both needed beside it. $D719 is written at the START of the nurse's dialogue, before HealParty runs - measured, a run with the flip alone as its goal stopped at the counter with the lead on 26/29 - so the flip alone proves the conversation began and not that the party was healed. party_missing_hp is the sum over the party of wPartyMonNMaxHP less wPartyMonNHP; a goal compares one number against a constant and 'current equals maximum' is not expressible that way, because the maximum moves with the party and with every level.

map=0x3A rather than being back outside: finishing inside the building is what forces anyone who is hurt through the nurse. An earlier version of the link after the gym used map=0x02 and fired at the GYM door for every attempt that came out whole - 23 of 60, in under ten decisions, having never gone near the Pokemon Center.
